chunks: I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about one who entered the Fire, then was removed from it, and then entered Paradise. He said, 'If you wish, I will tell you what my father used to say about it.' He said, 'Verily, some people will come out of the Fire after having been burnt to coals, and they will be taken to a river at the gate of Paradise called al-Hayawan (the Life). Water from it will be showered upon them, and their flesh, blood, and hair will grow back.'
ai.seo_question: What happens to those who are removed from Hellfire before entering Paradise?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) elucidates the Shia doctrine of *Khuruj min al-Nar* (exit from Hell), affirming that certain sinners undergo purification in Hell before eternal entry into Paradise. The specific mention of the 'River of Life' (*Nahr al-Hayawan*) highlights the physical restoration of the body, a concept supported by Shia exegetes who link this event to the intercessory power of the Ahl al-Bayt and the divine mercy that ensures no believer remains in Hell forever.

en.shaykh-tahir-ridha-jaffer: 3.Faḍālah narrated from ʿUmar ibn Abān who said,

“I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh (a) about one who is put in the Fire and then removed therefrom and placed in Paradise. He said, ‘If you wish, I will tell you about what my father used to say regarding it. He said, “Verily some people will come out of the Fire after having been burnt coal-black [by the Fire], and they will be taken to a river at the gate of Paradise which is called the [River of] Life (al-ḥayawān). Its water will then be showered upon them so their flesh, blood and hair will grow [back].”’”
